description: Figure 7 shows the distribution of articles across media outlets. The chart is a pie chart with four slices, each representing a different media outlet. The third largest slice, representing 21.0% of the articles, is for the outlet labeled "Questionable source." The smallest slice, representing 20.0% of the articles, is for the outlet labeled "Left center bias." The chart does not include a legend, percentage labels inside the slices, or any visually emphasized slices. The segments are ordered by size, with the largest slice at the top and the smallest slice at the bottom.
